description: Show the sites of the excellence roadmap side by side to the person, in the conversation: per theme the average level of each site, the overall average, the number of items below target, the assessment each site is judged on, and the items the sites are furthest apart on (where one plant has something to show another). Hosts that support MCP Apps display it; elsewhere you get the same content as text. Averages are over the items assessed, each shown with the number of items it stands on, and are a reading aid: a level is a step, not a grade. What each site is judged on (official, self-assessment, draft) is written under its name: say it when you comment. It compares; it ranks nobody and decides nothing.

lang.description: Language of the grid texts (en, fr, es, pt, de…); default: the language of your account if the roadmap is translated into it, else its source language

roadmap_id.description: UUID of the roadmap; optional when the organization has one

name: show_site_comparison
title: Compare sites
